description: Read one part call by call_id with the key that made it (with both agent_key and api_key, the one that made the call is used): state (locked, in_review, disputed, completed or failed), check, the sample, unlock steps and pay_link while it is held, what_happened when it failed, the whole result once paid, review_ends_at and any dispute. The supplier's key reads the state, the check and the dispute, not the result.
name: capability_call_get
title: Read a capability call
